'''Henry Bolt''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned on the [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]] [http://www.rockstargames.com/sanandreas/ website].

==Character history==
Henry Bolt was the [[Military|colonel]] of the 66th Cavalry stationed in [[Fort Carson]]. In [[1842]], he led them towards [[Las Barrancas]] and the entire force fell into a hole on their journey. A tribute, the Barrancas Mass Grave, stands in memory of Bolt and his forces.
